austin.summary: Austin, drafting 5th you lost two early — Jenna out 4th, Linnea out 6th — and yet here you sit at rank 3 of 5 with 38 counted points, because your back half is pure muscle. Carter and Eric are tied at the very top of the board, 2 of 4 still in the game. Draft GPA 2, but Ep 3 gave you +8 and Ep 6 only +2. The leader has 56. Thirty-four points still on the table.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric, your pick #16 steal, sits at 14 pts and rank 1 of 21 — a mental health counselor reading the room better than anyone out there.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna at pick #6 was the reach, going out 4th with 4 pts and a rank of 17 of 21, and Linnea's F grade right behind her left you digging out early.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Carter and Eric are both on Tovuto and both at 14 pts — if that tribe holds together, those 34 remaining points are yours to chase.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this draft — Aaliyah went home in Episode 1, and the First Blood badge is yours forever. But look what you did with pick #8: Cristian sits at 14 pts, rank 1 of 21, the steal of the whole thing. You're rank 4 of 5 with 32 counted points, eliminated from contention with the leader at 56, but there are 22 points still on the table and one castaway still breathing. That matters.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian Chavez, your pick #8, is the number one scorer in this entire game at 14 pts and he's still out there.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that broke your heart — 0 pts, rank 21 of 21, first one out the door.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You came off a worst week in Ep 6 at +2 and answered with +8 in Ep 7 — keep riding that Salt Lake City chaos and chase the 22 points left.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick in the snake and you built a Tovuto fortress — Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda all sitting at 14 pts, all ranked 1 of 21. That's 45 counted points, rank 2 of 5, with 3 of 5 still in the game and 46 points still on the table while the leader sits at 56. Ep 7 gave you +12. You're not chasing — you're hunting.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda Cox, your leftover at pick #21, is tied at the very top with 14 pts and a grade of A — the steal of this entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 was the reach, going out 3rd in Ep 3 with 3 pts and an F, while Rob's 2 pts get dropped under the best-4 rule — and that 2.4 draft GPA tells the story.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your roster already owns 2 necklaces and 2 idols and advantages found — keep an eye on whether that Immunity Hoarder and Idol Whisperer hardware keeps stacking as the merge grind continues.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and built a roster with muscle, mischief, and microphone talent — but the torches came fast. All 0 of 4 are still in the game, you're rank 5 of 5 with 31 counted points, and with 0 points still on the table while the leader has 56, contention is officially out of reach. Still: Torch Collector with 4 torches snuffed, Idol Whisperer with 2 found. Your crew made noise.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger, your pick #2 at 12 pts, led this team in scoring and lasted all the way to being named 1st & 2nd jury members.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani went out 2nd voted out in Ep 2 with 1 pts, ranking 20 of 21, and your Draft GPA of 1.25 tells that story in one number.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Brady at pick #19 ranking 13 was your steal of the draft, and your best week was Ep 7 (+7) — watch Kristin's voice on the jury as the rest of this season plays out.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted fourth and somehow walked off with the whole Tovuto crew — and the scoreboard shows it. Rank 1 of 5, 56 counted points, 4 of 4 still in the game, a Draft GPA of 3.75. Untouchable, Merge Machine, Wire-to-Wire, Idol Whisperer — that's a full badge rack. Ep 7 handed you +16. Eleven boots have come and gone, and not one of them was yours. Remarkable.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying this team — all four are, with Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An each sitting on 14 pts, rank 1 of 21, and Thien An at pick #17 is the steal of your draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: The only soft spot in this lineup is Lewis's grade B next to three A's, and Ep 1 was your quietest night at just +4.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 58 points still on the table with the leader at 56 — and with 2 idols and advantages already found on your roster, watch how your farmers, your actor and your med student use them.
